由题意知方程确定函数 $z=z(x,y)$，在题设方程两边取微分

得：$dF(x-y,y-z,z-x)=d0=0$

即有：$F_1'(dx-dy)+F_2'(dy-dz)+F_3'(dz-dx)=0$

合并得：$(F_1'-F_3')dx+(F_2'-F_1')dy=(F_2'-F_3')dz$

解得：$dz=\frac{F_1'-F_3'}{F_2'-F_3'}dx+\frac{F_2'-F_1'}{F_2'-F_3'}dy$，从而 $\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}=\frac{F_1'-F_3'}{F_2'-F_3'},\quad\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=\frac{F_2'-F_1'}{F_2'-F_3'}$

于是：$\frac{\partial z}{\partial x}+\frac{\partial z}{\partial y}=1$
